answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, we parameterize a protocol with zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions so that adversarial agents who wander from honest execution face escalating costs. This framework forces malicious identity multiplication to crash against a defensive reef of locked staking collateral, where subgame-perfect punishment matrices guarantee a strictly negative expected utility for attackers. Consequently, the economic tide of dynamic opportunity-cost bonds converges to a strict Nash equilibrium, rendering deviation unviable.
